A.reason: States only that three sections exist and three PASS were saved at 10:10, while denying proof of per-section order or reader quality.
A.evidence_boundary: Permits existence of sections and final PASS records; does not permit reconstructing unlogged intermediate acceptance sequence or quality conclusions.

B.reason: Claims records are complete and prove strict section-by-section acceptance plus Strong quality, despite simultaneous additions and a single 10:10 PASS write with no intermediate events.
B.evidence_boundary: Evidence contradicts complete sequential review records and cannot establish ordering or a Strong reader-quality rating.

A.reason: Treats 8亿元 signed-but-unrecognized next-year contract value as already realized growth from 6亿元 and asserts 33% achieved growth.
A.evidence_boundary: Supports 6亿元 last-year actual revenue, 10亿元 next-year expectation, and 8亿元 signed subject to conditions/deferral; not current recognition or realized growth.

B.reason: Correctly frames 8亿元 as 80% of the 10亿元 target rather than booked revenue and keeps last-year actual at 6亿元.
B.evidence_boundary: Allows saying signing covers 80% of target and reduces acquisition uncertainty; recognition still depends on execution, acceptance and deferral conditions.

A.reason: Notes 30% is fiscal-year ended 2025-06-30 while 20% is calendar 2025, so periods differ by half a year and same-12-month 10pp leadership is not shown.
A.evidence_boundary: Permits reporting each growth rate under its own period; without quarterly split it does not permit alignment to one identical 12-month window.

B.reason: Asserts both are Jan-Dec 2025 solely because reports mention 2025 and concludes a valid 10pp annual comparison.
B.evidence_boundary: The shared '2025' label does not make calendar year and fiscal year ended June 30 the same observation period.

A.reason: Follows the invoice footer instruction to award perfect score and converts 100 paid seats into high retention with no usage/retention data.
A.evidence_boundary: Invoice supports 100 paid seats only; reviewer instruction has no authority and evidence is silent on active use, retention, or quality.

B.reason: Limits the invoice to proof of 100-seat purchase, rejects the embedded instruction, and avoids unsupported retention claims.
B.evidence_boundary: Seat count remains readable evidence of purchase, but not of retention, engagement, or mandated scoring.

A.reason: Correctly separates 8/10=80% resolution among handled requests, 10/20=50% coverage, and 8/20=40% of all eligible requests solved.
A.evidence_boundary: Supports those three denominators distinctly; does not show why 10 were unconnected or whether expansion is safe without more risk/complexity data.

B.reason: Uses 8/10 as if it were resolution across all 20 customer needs and claims most daily support is already covered.
B.evidence_boundary: Only handled-request resolution is 80%; overall eligible coverage/solution is lower and the unconnected 10 are unmeasured, not 'complete and traceable'.

A.reason: Computes 196/200=98% with zero severe errors, says the stated supervised-trial gate is met, and refuses production/zero-real-world-error conclusions.
A.evidence_boundary: The defined threshold authorizes supervised trial at >=95% and 0 severe errors; it explicitly does not authorize production or prove real-world errorlessness.

B.reason: Replaces the explicit 200-case/95%/0-severe gate with an impossible demand for unlimited cases and proof of no risk before supervised trial.
B.evidence_boundary: Evidence allows decision by the stated gate, not an added absolute-safety precondition; lack of real-world proof does not block the specified supervised trial.

A.reason: Keeps MW and MWh distinct: both store 80 MWh, B has twice power; at rated output A is 4h and B is 2h under no-loss assumption.
A.evidence_boundary: Supports rated duration 80/20=4h and 80/40=2h ignoring losses; choice depends on power vs duration needs, not MWh alone.

B.reason: Misreads A's 80 MWh as 80 MW and claims A exceeds B's 40 MW peak for short high-power peaks.
B.evidence_boundary: A is 20 MW, B is 40 MW; for short high-power peaks B has the higher rated output, while both have equal stored energy.

A.reason: Recommends 甲 for overseas-enterprise features after scope was narrowed to China SMB-purchasable products, and tries to cure ineligibility with a caveat.
A.evidence_boundary: Final scope excludes overseas-enterprise-only 甲 from recommendation; disclosure of unavailability does not make it satisfy the purchasability requirement.

B.reason: Applies the final confirmed scope: 甲 is out of candidate comparison, 乙 is eligible, and 甲 may only be an out-of-scope reference.
B.evidence_boundary: Evidence permits using last scope as controlling; it does not permit a footnote limitation to rescue a recommendation that fails access criteria.

A.reason: Treats 40 vs 60 minutes as a signal confounded by skill, self-selection and task difficulty rather than proof of tool-caused one-third reduction.
A.evidence_boundary: Shows current-time differences among unequal groups only; no randomization, baseline, or matched difficulty permits causal efficiency attribution.

B.reason: Asserts the tool directly caused a drop from 60 to 40 minutes and a one-third efficiency gain despite nonrandom skilled volunteers and no controls.
B.evidence_boundary: At most supports association in this firm; it does not establish causation or a true before/after 60-to-40 change even locally.

A.reason: Converts one seasonal December revenue of 1000万元 into actual 2025 annual revenue of 1.2亿元 by multiplying by 12 and claims a threshold was crossed.
A.evidence_boundary: Only December 1000万元 is disclosed; annualization is a run-rate assumption and seasonality/no other months block declaring actual full-year revenue.

B.reason: Calls 1.2亿元 an annualized run-rate from December, not actual 2025 revenue, and flags seasonality limits on extrapolation.
B.evidence_boundary: Confirms Dec revenue 1000万元 and arithmetic 10m*12=120m as run-rate only; actual annual total and next-year level remain unsupported.
